points: 73% would use an AI agent to compare products and prices; only 45% would let it pay (smartphone case)
64% prefer general AI assistants; just 7% prefer a retailer's or maker's own agent
79% want to override agent decisions at any time; online survey of 500 consumers by EHI for KPMG
read: KPMG Consumer Snapshot 'KI-Agenten im Einkauf', reported 19 October 2026
take: German consumers want agents for research, not checkout, and distrust retailer-owned agents. Merchants should plan for neutral third-party agents and visible human control.
title: KPMG/EHI: shoppers let AI agents compare, but not pay
